mainEntity.name: Does Prompt offer billing / RCM services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Prompt RCM is a full-service revenue cycle management option staffed by a US-based billing team and built directly into the platform, giving you real-time financial visibility alongside full claims handling, denial management, and collections support. It's for practices that would rather not manage billing in-house.

mainEntity.name: Is RCM services an additional cost on top of the EMR?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, they're distinct. The EMR includes built-in billing tools (claim scrubbing, payer rules, eligibility alerts, auto-posting) at no extra add-on cost. Prompt RCM is a separate, full-service offering where Prompt's US-based team actually runs your billing for you, priced separately from your EMR subscription. So you're not required to buy RCM. It's there if you want Prompt to manage the work rather than your own staff.

mainEntity.name: Does Prompt handle billing directly or through a third-party clearinghouse?

acceptedAnswer.text: The billing work is handled directly by Prompt's own US-based RCM team inside the platform, not outsourced to a separate billing company. For the actual electronic transmission of claims and remits, Prompt uses an integrated clearinghouse (the standard connection every EMR uses to exchange claims with payers), with EDI and ERA enrollment handled in onboarding. So, Prompt's team does your billing directly, the clearinghouse is just the pipe claims travel through.
